# Spin glass foundations dependency slice

This tree retains the selected recursive dependencies from [ParisiFormula](https://github.com/qiangwu2/ParisiFormula), revision `9fd12231429de72fa524b471c43f4a237553a711`, and [research_public/RSAT](https://github.com/njimaMath/research_public/tree/f3b34d2071d9cde5262c6672b6ebab132d4a7b43/RSAT), revision `f3b34d2071d9cde5262c6672b6ebab132d4a7b43`. Their Apache 2.0 licenses are retained separately as [LICENSE-ParisiFormula](LICENSE-ParisiFormula) and [LICENSE-RSAT](LICENSE-RSAT). Original source notices remain. [PROVENANCE.json](PROVENANCE.json) records upstream sources and historical adaptations; [the license inventory](../../docs/LICENSES.json) attributes each retained file.

The imported `SpinGlass.Targets.parisi_formula` concerns convergence of quenched finite SK free entropy to the infimum of the finite-step Parisi functional, with covariance `N β² R²/2`. This includes a diagonal common Gaussian shift relative to the unordered-pair convention. Equality with another Hamiltonian convention requires a covariance comparison and treatment of that mean-zero shift. General probability-measure PDE and variational identification are additional bridges in the enclosing development.

The strict-AT theorem constructs uniform finite-size bounds under compactness, positive inverse temperature/field, and the strict AT inequality. Gaussian disorder conditions are explicit distribution and independence hypotheses. The canonical replica-symmetric fixed point is selected from interval-valued fixed points; its proved positive-field uniqueness identifies an arbitrary fixed point with that selector.

Historical adaptations removed three unused unfinished declarations from `Targets.Milestones` and replaced finite cavity `native_decide` uses by kernel `decide`. [COMPATIBILITY.patch](COMPATIBILITY.patch) records the prior compiler adaptation. The selected source tree omits the unused `Lemmas.Gaussian.ConcreteModel` module; its historical provenance record remains marked as excluded.

The supplied provenance reports successful builds and standard-axiom audits on Lean 4.32.1 upstream and Lean 4.34.1 after adaptation. Those historical checks do not verify this repository’s current sources. Historical standalone audit modules and raw logs are excluded. Historical adapted hashes identify pre-port bytes; the enclosing [verification record](../../docs/VERIFICATION.md) reports current revision checks.
